1globals


2    constant integer MAX_COUNT = 10


3    integer array gCounters


4    boolean gInitialized = false


5endglobals


6


7native DisplayTextToPlayer takes player toPlayer, real x, real y, string message returns nothing


8native GetLocalPlayer takes nothing returns player


9


10function IsEven takes integer value returns boolean


11    return value - (value / 2) * 2 == 0


12endfunction


13


14function InitCounters takes nothing returns nothing


15    local integer i = 0


16    loop


17        exitwhen i >= MAX_COUNT


18        set gCounters[i] = 0


19        set i = i + 1


20    endloop


21    set gInitialized = true


22endfunction


23


24function SumCounters takes nothing returns integer


25    local integer i = 0


26    local integer total = 0


27    loop


28        exitwhen i >= MAX_COUNT


29        set total = total + gCounters[i]


30        set i = i + 1


31    endloop


32    return total


33endfunction


34


35function Main takes nothing returns nothing


36    call InitCounters()


37    if IsEven(SumCounters()) then


38        call DisplayTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(), 0, 0, "even")


39    else


40        call DisplayTextToPlayer(GetLocalPlayer(), 0, 0, "odd")


41    endif


42endfunction
